source_of_truth: events.jsonl (378 events); all numeric fields independently recomputed
notes: Rev 4 creates this bundle. index.md described NALex_PHASE_PROFILE as already embedded in CURRENT_STATE_CLEAN.md; it was not present in the delivered artifact set.
problematic_tags and emotional_tags are Claude-assigned analytic labels, not measured quantities. emotional_tags are INTERPRETATION.
Word counts differ from baseline_comparison_audit.json by <0.3% due to tokenizer choice; all other integer metrics reproduce exactly.
Medians are reported unrounded; on even-length samples they fall on .5 (Baseline Alex 31.5, Conflict Naomi 39.5).

problematic_tags.naomi_volume_dominance: Naomi out-words Alex by a wide margin in the phase
problematic_tags.naomi_wpm_escalation: Naomi's per-turn length rises sharply relative to prior phase
problematic_tags.naomi_unanswered_bid_rate_high: ~50% of Naomi's questions get no other-party turn within 10 min in-session
problematic_tags.naomi_post_exit_continuation: Substantial output after the other party has left the session
problematic_tags.naomi_unilateral_initiation: Naomi opens all sessions in the phase
problematic_tags.naomi_never_closes_verbally: Zero explicit sign-off moves in the phase
problematic_tags.alex_low_content_initiation: Alex's session opens are mostly single-turn drops that generate no exchange
problematic_tags.alex_terse_turn_floor: Alex's median turn length is roughly half Naomi's or lower
problematic_tags.alex_bimodal_turn_length: Low median with rare very long turns; mean masks the floor
problematic_tags.alex_question_burst_pressure: Runs of >=3 consecutive Alex turns each carrying a question
problematic_tags.alex_explicit_termination_moves: Verbal sign-offs used to end live exchanges
problematic_tags.alex_zero_initiation: Alex opens no sessions in the phase
problematic_tags.alex_topic_contingent_availability: Engages readily on neutral topics, exits soon after grievance topics are raised
problematic_tags.dyad_question_crossfire: Both parties above 35 questions per 100 turns simultaneously
problematic_tags.dyad_mutual_non_answering: Both parties' questions go unaddressed at comparable rates
problematic_tags.dyad_low_contact_high_burst: Few contact days, very high events per contact day
problematic_tags.dyad_no_closure_event: Phase ends without a mutual termination or repair turn

emotional_tags.naomi_chronic_unanswered_bids: INTERPRETATION: sustained experience of questions not landing
emotional_tags.naomi_unwitnessed: INTERPRETATION: posture of speaking without confirmation of being heard
emotional_tags.naomi_pursuing: INTERPRETATION: initiation and volume consistent with pursuit
emotional_tags.naomi_escalating_elaboration: INTERPRETATION: adding length in response to non-response
emotional_tags.naomi_seeking_acknowledgement: INTERPRETATION: explicit and repeated demand for acknowledgement over resolution
emotional_tags.naomi_anticipatory_vigilance: INTERPRETATION: sharply reduced latency consistent with monitoring
emotional_tags.alex_withdrawal_by_exit: INTERPRETATION: managing load by ending exchanges rather than escalating
emotional_tags.alex_over_vigilant_pursuit: INTERPRETATION: high-frequency questioning consistent with alarm-seeking
emotional_tags.alex_feeling_ambushed: INTERPRETATION: stated experience of being blamed or attacked without warning
emotional_tags.alex_defended_invulnerability: INTERPRETATION: asserted imperviousness to harm as a protective stance
emotional_tags.dyad_asymmetric_repair_expectation: INTERPRETATION: each waits for the other to perform the first repair move

notes: 4 of Alex's 5 session opens are 1-2 turn drops that produce no exchange.
5 of Naomi's 12 questions occur in sessions Alex never joins; her unanswered rate is largely structural absence, not selective refusal.
Latency medians rest on 7 (Naomi) and 8 (Alex) observations.
148 of 218 conversational events (68%) fall in two sessions: 26-27 Jun (77 ev / 276 min) and 4-5 Jul (71 ev / 332 min).
36 events carry approximate or minute-only timestamps; Conflict latency medians move with how these are handled.
The documented Alex unanswered figure (15/44) is roughly double any mechanical timing rule (7/44). It is a content-level judgment and is not reproducible from events.jsonl.
6.8-day gap measured event-to-event (5 Jul 00:53 -> 11 Jul 20:07). Broken by Naomi.
Naomi opens 5/5 and closes 5/5 sessions; Alex opens 0 and closes 0. In Baseline and Conflict Alex closed the majority (6/10 and 7/10).
2,585 of Naomi's 6,860 words (37.7%) are produced after Alex has left the session or in sessions he never joins.
Alex issues 4 explicit sign-offs; Naomi issues 0 in the entire corpus.

CAVEAT: the Aftermath window is 100% audio (105/105). The Conflict phase contained 69 text events (38 Alex / 31 Naomi). If Alex replied by text in July, those turns are absent by construction, and initiation/unanswered figures are upper bounds on the asymmetry. Naomi's turns in the two 'Naomi-only' sessions visibly respond to live Alex input.

sha256_coverage.note: All 77 sha256-less events are in the Conflict phase. The 'always join on sha256' invariant cannot be applied to the Conflict text thread.
